title: Retail payment initiation and confirmation journey
workflow: Select authorized source, recipient and amount with transparent fee quote
Validate account state, limits, mandate and beneficiary requirements server-side
Show complete recipient, currency, amount, estimated charges and transfer type
Collect authorized confirmation and step-up tied to the immutable request digest
Submit a single idempotent payment command through approved payments domain
Show distinct ACK, processing, outcome-unknown, settled and reconciled states
invariants: Client may not label transport ACK as settled funds
Repeated confirmation uses original command identity, never duplicates debit
Quoted fees and applied fees must reference approved schedule
Unknown external outcome cannot be blindly resubmitted
Disputed rail/participation evidence means capability disabled
Original posted journal remains immutable even when returned/reversed
acceptance_tests: Two taps on confirmation cause one command
Changing recipient after challenge invalidates approval
Pending transfer not displayed as final settlement
External timeout enters unknown outcome with trace
independent_gate: Institution-approved rail participation, payment APIs, CFO ledger mapping, customer mandate and actual transaction tests.
